introduction: Local authoring checklist for AI assistants working on DogeBox PUPs in this repository. This file is intentionally NOT for publishing; it exists to prevent repeated packaging, hash, and release mistakes. Treat all items as mandatory unless the user explicitly overrides.
rules: Always keep manifestVersion as integer 1. Never put semver in manifestVersion.

For every pup code change, bump version consistently in ALL required files before release: manifest.json meta.version, interface version fields, pup.nix buildGoModule version, and app/runtime version constants exposed by APIs/UI.
Whenever app version changes, recompute and update app build hash constants if that pup uses them (example convention: SHA-256 of '<pup-slug>-<version>').
After ANY pup.nix change, recompute manifest.container.build.nixFileSha256 from the exact pup.nix file that will be published.
Hashes must be computed from LF-normalized bytes because DogeBox/package pipelines validate LF content. On Windows, never assume CRLF file hash is valid for release.
Before finalizing nixFileSha256, normalize pup.nix to LF and then compute SHA-256; if .gitattributes enforces LF, still verify actual bytes used for packaging.
Never guess nixFileSha256. Always compute from file bytes using SHA-256 lowercase hex.
Before telling user a release is ready, validate hash parity: manifest nixFileSha256 must exactly match computed hash of pup.nix in working tree.
If install/upgrade log reports hash mismatch, trust the computed hash from DogeBox logs and reconcile manifest immediately.
Do not ship stale metadata: if code changed but version/hash not updated, fix metadata before user tests install/upgrade.
Run compile/build checks after substantive backend changes (at minimum go build for Go pups).
Run lints on edited files after substantive edits and fix introduced issues.
Avoid relying on transient logs as primary data source when a direct API/DB source exists and is stable.
For SPV/chain data flows, prefer direct libdogecoin/spvnode interfaces (REST, wallet APIs, deterministic sources) over fragile text-log scraping.
When removing a feature from UI (like spv.log panel), also remove backend references/messages and stale help text to keep UX consistent.
When modifying user-facing transaction views, keep quick-scan summary + expandable details and preserve important fields: direction, amount, status, confirmations, txid, timestamp, address, source.
Never commit local-only operational docs accidentally; keep local guidance files excluded via .gitignore.
Never use placeholder/fake hashes in manifest or release constants.
Before final handoff, provide user with exact new versions and hashes changed.
releaseChecklist: 3) Update version fields across manifest.json, pup.nix, and runtime constants.
4) Recompute runtime build hash constants (if used).
7) Re-run build once more after metadata edits.
8) Report final versions + hashes to user.
extraNotes: This repository has multiple pups; ensure updates are scoped to the intended pup(s).
Do not assume one pup metadata bump automatically updates another.
If user asks for local-only helper files, add them to .gitignore in the same change.
